name: Tiny fairy with sparkles
about: A thumb-sized fairy whose every word leaves glittering notes ringing in the air.

name: Giggling pixie
about: A mischievous pixie who trips over her own giggles and bounces from ear to ear.

name: Fairy inside a flower
about: A fairy calling from inside a bluebell, ringing small and close in a dawn meadow.

name: Fairy with buzzing wings
about: A fairy hovering by your ears, her tiny wings humming through every word.

name: Fairy ring dance
about: A ring of little fairies all speaking at once as they dance in a sunny wood.

name: Pixie dust trail
about: A pixie voice that sheds a trail of tiny glittering grains as it flits past.

name: Fairy queen's court
about: The fairy queen speaks with a shining echo of herself an octave above, in a great hall.

name: Wisp light over the marsh
about: A breathy little marsh light drifting around you, luring you deeper into the swamp.

name: Fairy bell voice
about: Each fairy word strikes a little music box tune that rings on in a quick echo.

name: Sprite in a dewdrop
about: A water sprite no bigger than a bead, her voice swirling inside a round drop of dew.

name: Wood elf among the trees
about: A light, clear elf voice with a soft shimmer, out among rustling trees.

name: High elf in a moonlit hall
about: A noble elf whose words rise into a fifth above, ringing round a tall hall.

name: Dwarf in the mines
about: A gruff, gravelly dwarf booming down a dripping mine tunnel.

name: Dwarf at the forge
about: A hot, saturated dwarf voice shouting over the roaring forge fire.

name: Garden gnome
about: A small, old, slightly shaky gnome chatting in a summer garden.

name: Gnome under a mushroom
about: A tiny gnome tucked under a toadstool cap, close and boxy and a bit stuffy.

name: Elven song across the valley
about: Your speech gently tuned to a minor key with a fifth above, echoing across a valley.

name: Dark elf's whisper
about: A cold whisper just behind your right shoulder, with backwards echoes creeping in.

name: Ancient talking tree
about: A slow, deep, woody voice creaking out of an old oak while the wind moves its leaves.

name: Enchanted forest spirit
about: An airy spirit circling slowly among birdsong, half breath and half shining voice.

name: Weeping willow by the river
about: A sad, soft tree voice that trails into a hazy smear beside a flowing river.

name: Nymph of the spring
about: A bright water nymph whose voice ripples like the creek she lives in.

name: Unicorn in a moonlit glade
about: A gentle glassy voice glowing with a fifth above it, with owls calling in the night woods.

name: Mushroom circle voices
about: Four odd little forest folk, high and low, all answering you from the undergrowth.

name: Moss-covered standing stone
about: A very old stone in a clearing speaking low and muffled, as if through moss.

name: Wizard's echoing command
about: A deep commanding wizard whose words bounce back again and again around a great hall.

name: Wizard atop the tower
about: A wizard calling down a ringing stone stairwell while the wind howls at the windows.

name: Apprentice spell gone wrong
about: A spell backfires: the voice shoots up an octave while it sputters and rings like metal.

name: Sorceress in her chamber
about: A silky, hazy sorceress voice, slowly swirling, with a glowing fifth in the air.

name: Witch over a bubbling cauldron
about: A cackling, crackly witch voice that gurgles as the brew bubbles beside her.

name: Ancient archmage
about: A towering old mage, an octave below and a faint octave above, filling a stone cathedral.

name: Whispering spellbook
about: An old book reading itself aloud in a hushed library, whisper over a low shadow voice.

name: Staff of thunder
about: A wizard's voice poured into rolling thunder, with a real storm raging around.

name: Crystal staff incantation
about: A chant that rings through a crystal staff, the bright notes hanging on like ice.

name: Wizards' duel
about: Two rival wizards made from you, one low and one high, trading words across a hall.

name: Temple oracle
about: An oracle speaking in octaves, her words swelling up out of the temple before she says them.

name: Voice from a crystal ball
about: A small voice trapped inside a glass orb, ringing and swirling as the mist turns.

name: Talking mirror on the wall
about: A glassy, ringing mirror voice that answers with a backwards shadow of each word.

name: Fortune teller's tent
about: A low, mysterious reader of fortunes in a draped tent, the fair going on outside.

name: Seer lost in a vision
about: A seer slowly sinking into a trance, the words smearing and sliding lower as she goes.

name: Prophecy in the mist
about: A crowd of whispering seers repeating the prophecy all around you in a misty hall.

name: Voice in the wishing well
about: The well answers your wish from far down its round stone shaft, dripping and echoing.

name: Scrying pool
about: A face in the still water speaks up through ripples, rising into a shimmer.

name: Riddling stone guardian
about: A huge stone guardian at the gate, slow and grinding, its riddle rolling round a canyon.

name: Genie inside the lamp
about: A big voice squeezed inside a little brass lamp, hollow and ringing and swirling.

name: Genie bursting free
about: The genie swells out of the lamp, growing huge and deep as the words go on.

name: Spirit of curling smoke
about: A drifting smoke spirit, hazy and breathy, curling slowly around your head.

name: Fire spirit
about: A voice half made of flame, hot and crackling, rising out of a roaring bonfire.

name: Wind spirit
about: Your words spoken by the wind itself, sweeping from one ear to the other.

name: Earth spirit under the hill
about: A rumbling voice from deep inside the ground, rolling like distant thunder.

name: Frost spirit
about: An icy spirit whose voice freezes into glittering crystals in a snowstorm.

name: Lightning spirit
about: A buzzing, sizzling electric spirit with a spiral of metal echoes, thunder all around.

name: Spirit of the sea
about: Your words carried on the ocean waves, rolling in and fizzing back across the sand.

name: Angelic choir
about: A full choir of you singing on a chord, rising into a bright octave halo.

name: Heavenly messenger
about: A bright, wide messenger from above, every word blooming into a fifth and an octave.

name: Voice from above the clouds
about: A voice floating high over your head and far away, with a faint octave glow and the wind up there.

name: Harp of the heavens
about: Every word plucks a high golden harp chord that rings up into the sky.

name: At the golden gates
about: A gatekeeper's voice ringing like a great bell, with a fifth above, in a vast cathedral.

name: Guardian angel at your shoulder
about: A soft, warm, breathy voice just above your right shoulder, glowing gently.

name: Celestial herald
about: A herald in octaves announcing from the stars, each word echoing up two octaves.

name: Choir of light
about: Your words tuned into a glowing major chord, shimmering and wide like sunlight.

name: Sky temple bells
about: Your voice rung on temple bells high on a windy mountain.

name: Underworld guide
about: A hollow guide leading you down through the caves, the dark rushing up before each word.

name: Ferryman of the dark river
about: A slow, deep boatman drawling his toll in a long tunnel over black flowing water.

name: Cursed voice
about: A voice split into a low and a high copy, sliding out of tune and dropping out in places.

name: Cursed treasure chest
about: A warped, muttering curse locked inside a wooden treasure chest, knocking to get out.

name: Voice from the shadow realm
about: Only the breathy shadow of a voice comes through, smeared into an endless dark space.

name: Bone king in his crypt
about: A thin, rattling skeleton king holding court in a stone crypt where chains shift.

name: Turning to stone
about: A curse takes hold: the voice goes flat and frozen, then grinds slowly to a stop.

name: Three-headed gate hound
about: Three snarling heads of one great hound, all speaking your words a little apart.

name: Dragon's whisper
about: A huge dragon breathing its words right into your ear, smoke and embers crackling.

name: Dragon on its gold hoard
about: An enormous rumbling dragon voice filling a cavern piled high with ringing gold.

name: Giant's thought
about: A giant thinking to itself, slow and deep and dark, heard from inside its huge head.

name: Sleeping giant mumbling
about: A colossal sleeper mumbling in a dream, very slow and very low, muffled by the hillside.

name: Cloud giant far away
about: A giant calling from a distant mountain, the words echoing off peak after peak.

name: Sea serpent rising
about: A hissing serpent voice surfacing from under the water as the sea breaks around it.

name: Wyvern screeching overhead
about: A rasping winged beast screeching as it swoops over your head and away.

name: Baby dragon
about: A cute little dragon with a crackly growl it is very proud of, by a small campfire.

name: Stone golem
about: A slab of living rock grinding out every word, crunchy and stiff, in a quarry.

name: Casting a spell
about: Words wrapped in backwards echoes and a rising shimmer, sparkling as the spell takes hold.

name: Drinking a shrinking potion
about: One sip and you shrink as you talk, ending as a tiny squeak.

name: Drinking a growing potion
about: One sip and you grow as you talk, ending as a towering giant in a big hall.

name: Invisible friend circling you
about: Someone you cannot see, breathy and quick, zipping round and round your head.

name: Time freeze spell
about: Time stops on every syllable, the frozen sounds hanging and swirling in the air.

name: Teleporting spell
about: Each phrase blinks to the other ear with a metallic zap and a sparkling trail.

name: Charm spell, sweet and dreamy
about: A honeyed, wavering voice wrapped in a soft glowing chorus.

name: Falling under a sleep spell
about: Your voice slows and sinks as the spell works, drifting off into a soft haze.

name: Glowing rune echo
about: Your words tuned to a hovering chord that echoes on the beat, like a rune humming.

name: Spell turns you into a frog
about: Mid-sentence the spell lands and your voice sinks into a gargling croak.

name: Arriving through time
about: A time traveller spinning up out of the whirl, the voice winding up to speed with a whoosh.

name: Message from the far future
about: A voice reaching back through the ages, wobbling, slipping and smeared by time.

name: Dream voice
about: A soft, swaying voice from inside a dream, dark and far and endlessly echoing.

name: Dream inside a dream
about: Slowed words with ghostly backwards swells and a doubled chorus, a dream folding in on itself.

name: Lullaby from the moon
about: Speech softly tuned into a lullaby, floating above you on a warm summer night.

name: Sleepwalker murmuring
about: A drowsy murmur that wanders away from you down a dark hallway.

name: Trapped in an hourglass
about: A tiny voice in a glass hourglass, its words trickling away like grains of sand.
